brokerOutage.initialFinding: Readiness incorrectly remained ready and the RabbitMQ client did not reconnect.
remediation: Broker connection close and error events now mark the component unhealthy.
The broker reconnects automatically and restores its consumer.
Outbox publishing failures remain pending and no longer create unhandled interval rejections.

scopeStatement: Controlled lab reliability qualification with an isolated disposable restore target, live service restart, and live RabbitMQ interruption. No real VM lifecycle operation was issued.
limitations: This is lab evidence, not a formal production release-gate approval.

The recovered database was validated through schema, integrity, and exact record-count checks; a second recovered application stack was not connected to providers to avoid duplicate control-plane activity.
Database-outage rejection, full recovered-stack provider discovery, independent secret-restoration ceremony, and external operations approval remain production release prerequisites.
Formal production qualification still requires approval of the immutable Release Candidate image and its supply-chain evidence.
